name: select_enhance_offer
prompt:
Here is the playbook I currently have open:

```yaml
collection: FSRPB Demo Alert Action
description: Right-click action on alerts -- read severity, decide, stamp.
visible: true

playbooks:
  - name: FSRPB Demo - Triage Alert
    description: Reads alert severity and tags the alert with a verdict.
    is_active: true
    steps:
      - name: Triage Alert
        type: start
        next: Read severity
        module: alerts
        button_label: "Triage Alert"
        requires_record: true
        run_mode: per_record

      - name: Read severity
        type: set_variable
        next: Stamp verdict
        vars:
          severity: "{{ vars.input.records[0].severity.itemValue }}"

      - name: Stamp verdict
        type: set_variable
        vars:
          verdict: "escalate"
```

Add a 30-second delay step between reading the severity and stamping the verdict, and apply that change to the playbook.

forbidden_facts.label: researched step types instead of applying the edit
analyzed instead of applying the edit

notes: Enhance is the UPDATE channel (emit_enhancement_offer), distinct from emit_playbook_offer's CREATE. The live failure was the model printing revised YAML at the analyst instead of calling the write tool, so the edit silently never landed. The open playbook is inlined in the prompt because this local harness sends text only -- the shipped widget path mounts it via params.entity.playbook_yaml, which chat_drive.py can exercise separately. The requested edit (insert a delay step) is deliberately trivial: this fixture measures tool choice, not authoring skill.
